question: Is the public evidence sufficient to hide/quarantine or require renaming of `@kingaiwork/shieldcortex` as an impersonating ShieldCortex namespace?
rationale: The live listing remains public and creates an ambiguous slug collision with the established listing, but evidence sufficiency and enforcement remedy are staff trust-and-safety judgments rather than code automation.

options.title: Hide or quarantine now
options.body: If staff accepts the public evidence, remove the disputed listing from public install/discovery and audit the moderation reason while deciding any follow-up rename, transfer, or reservation.

options.title: Request publisher response or rename
options.body: If staff wants more process before takedown, require the current publisher to rename or justify the listing by a short deadline while keeping the issue open.

options.title: Decline the claim
options.body: If staff decides the evidence does not establish impersonation or ownership, leave the listing live and document the reason for declining.

recommendation.title: Hide or quarantine now
recommendation.body: If staff accepts the public evidence, remove the disputed listing from public install/discovery and audit the moderation reason while deciding any follow-up rename, transfer, or reservation.
